name: Four Seasons San Francisco at Embarcadero
positioning: Luxury hotel in the top 11 floors of a 48-storey tower at Sansome and California Streets in San Francisco's Financial District
best_for: Travelers who want panoramic views of the San Francisco Bay and skyline
Guests who want to be steps from the California cable car route

facts.text: Guest rooms are located on the top 11 floors of the 48-storey building.
The hotel is at 222 Sansome Street, San Francisco.
The hotel's opening date as a Four Seasons is October 2020.
The hotel's restaurant is Orafo, on the ground floor lobby level.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The hotel offers complimentary premium Wi-Fi.
San Francisco International Airport is a 20-minute drive from the hotel.

highlights.text: Large windows frame panoramic views of the San Francisco Bay, Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge and Transamerica Pyramid.
Sky Bridges on most of the guest room floors offer guests a panoramic view of the Bay and city.
A complimentary Sky Flow Yoga class is held on the open-air 40th floor terrace, weather permitting.
The Golden Gate Terrace Presidential Suite opens onto a large furnished terrace.
The California Street cable car line is steps from the hotel.

considerations.text: Fisherman's Wharf and Pier 39 are roughly a 30-minute walk or a 10-minute drive from the hotel.
Union Square is about a 12 to 15-minute walk from the hotel.
The Superior Skyline-View Room is 350 sq. ft. (33 m2).
The Fitness Centre is exclusively for Four Seasons guests ages 16 years and over.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
